claims.claim: Direct tokumbo engine / Direct from Belgium
claims.evidence: No shipping documents, customs clearance, or port tags are visible in the report.
The report shows the engine sitting on a floor; there is no video of it running or compression test data.
No odometer reading from the donor vehicle or service history is provided.
Close-up photos of the factory sealant (RTV) and cylinder head bolts are missing.

risks.risk: Internal mechanical failure (e.g., seized, rod knock, or blown head gasket).
risks.proof: A video clip of the engine starting and idling, or a dry/wet compression test report.
risks.if_unproven: as a non-functional core for parts/scrap.

risks.risk: Incorrect model or compatibility for the buyer's vehicle.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine code or serial number stamped on the block.
A video showing the transmission shifting through gears or a report on the fluid condition.
risks.if_unproven: as a core requiring a total rebuild.

proof_requests: Photo of the engine model code and serial number stamped on the engine block.
Video of the engine running (if possible) or a manual crank test to ensure it is not seized.
Photos of the engine oil dipstick and the underside of the oil filler cap.
Importation documents or 'Tokunbo' papers to verify origin.
response.reason: The witness identified the item as an engine and transmission but could not determine the brand or model. Without knowing the specific engine model, it is impossible to provide even a worst-case price.
